name: smart-title
description: 对话演进时自动刷新会话标题，支持 /smart-title 立即刷新与历史会话批量回填；用户手动改过的标题永不覆盖。

description_i18n.en: Refreshes session titles as the conversation evolves, with /smart-title manual refresh and batch backfill for older sessions. Titles renamed by hand are never overwritten.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 对话演进时自动刷新会话标题，支持 /smart-title 立即刷新与历史会话批量回填；用户手动改过的标题永不覆盖。
